qualifier: post-embryonic lens and cornea maturation with developmental apoptosis and hyaloid regression
name: Post-embryonic eye maturation with lens and hyaloid regression
rationale: All members concern eye structure development (lens, cornea, eyelid, retina, ocular vasculature); unlike the embryonic optic cup/iris, lacrimal or retinal-vasculature confusables, this theme centres on post-embryonic lens/anterior eye maturation and developmental cell death including hyaloid vessel regression.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and fusion
name: Calcium-triggered presynaptic neurotransmitter vesicle exocytosis
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles, vesicle docking/priming/SNARE assembly and calcium-dependent exocytosis at the presynapse, distinguishing it from confusables about vesicle recycling/endocytosis or postsynaptic glutamate receptor signaling.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC with prefoldin, actin and tubulin substrates
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe de novo cytosolic folding by the CCT/TRiC chaperonin and prefoldin, notably of actin and tubulin, unlike confusables on ER/refolding chaperones, tubulin modification or telomerase assembly.

qualifier: C-type lectin receptors and IL-17/Th17 axis
name: Antifungal C-type lectin receptor and IL-17 immunity
rationale: Members combine fungal sensing by Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN with IL-17/IL-23/Th17 and IL-36/IL-38 epithelial cytokine signaling, distinguishing it from confusables centred on IL-12/IL-23 receptor signaling or IL-10/IL-27 regulatory cytokines.

core: vitamin and cofactor transport and metabolism
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol, with CYP disorders
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinol metabolism and CYP disorders
rationale: Most members concern thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinone/quinone transport or synthesis, plus inherited CYP1B1/CYP2U1/CYP7B1 and SLCO2A1 defects of lipophilic metabolite handling; this separates it from cobalamin, coenzyme A and carnitine/choline confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment and rod/cone development
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine primary-cilium membrane cargo targeting (BBSome, VxPx, ARL13B-INPP5E, myristoylated proteins, basal body anchoring) with photoreceptor outer segment and rod/cone development, distinguishing it from intraflagellar transport, motile cilia and non-ciliary retinal differentiation confusables.

qualifier: Fanconi interstrand crosslink repair, monoubiquitination and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects
name: Fanconi anemia crosslink repair and BRCA1/BRCA2 dysfunction
rationale: Members cover Fanconi anemia interstrand crosslink repair with its monoubiquitination/deubiquitination switch and defective BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 responses, unlike confusables centred on NHEJ, end resection/homologous recombination or protein-DNA crosslink repair.

qualifier: arterial, venous and lymphatic fate
name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate commitment and differentiation into arterial (dorsal aorta), venous and lymphatic identities, whereas confusables emphasise vasculogenesis, vessel maturation, BMP signaling or cardiopulmonary artery morphogenesis.

qualifier: inherited surfactant dysfunction disorders
name: Pulmonary surfactant homeostasis and its inherited disorders
rationale: Every member concerns surfactant metabolism or diseases of surfactant proteins/ABCA3, distinguishing it from lipoprotein/phospholipid efflux and lung epithelial differentiation confusables.

core: polyamine metabolism and amino acid residue modification
qualifier: protein methylation/hydroxylation and hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine synthesis
name: Polyamine metabolism with protein methylation and hypusine/diphthamide modification
rationale: Members span polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport together with protein lysine/arginine methylation, hydroxylation and special residue modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine); the polyamine and methylation arms separate it from translation-factor, methionine salvage and tRNA confusables.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and translation
name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Nearly all members concern mitochondrial DNA replication/repair, transcription, RNA processing/stability, ribosome assembly and translation, unlike confusables limited to RNA pseudouridylation/methylation or nuclear tRNA processing.

qualifier: postsynaptic receptor localization and synaptic cytoskeleton
name: Postsynaptic receptor trafficking and synaptic cytoskeleton organization
rationale: Members cover AMPA/neurotransmitter receptor delivery, localization and internalization plus pre- and postsynaptic cytoskeleton and active zone organization, distinguishing it from confusables on clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis or Rab/ARF signaling.

qualifier: lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
name: Protein lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members concern methylation or hydroxylation of protein amino acid residues, distinguishing it from acetylation, histone-chromatin methylation and translation-factor modification confusables.

qualifier: elastic fibers and collagen fibrils
name: Elastic fiber assembly and collagen fibril organization
rationale: Members concern elastic fiber components/assembly and collagen fibril organization, unlike confusables about basement membrane, fibronectin/integrin adhesion or collagen biosynthesis.

qualifier: migration, homing and NADPH oxidase activation
name: Leukocyte Rho GTPase signaling for migration and NADPH oxidase
rationale: Members link RHOH/Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signaling to leukocyte homing, dendritic cell chemotaxis and Rho-driven NADPH oxidase/antimicrobial activity, distinguishing it from immunological synapse and chemokine-receptor confusables.

qualifier: netrin-DCC and ephrin cues
name: Netrin-DCC and ephrin growth cone guidance signaling
rationale: Members are netrin attraction/repulsion, ephrin/EPHA growth cone collapse, RAC1 activation and axon fasciculation, distinguishing it from L1, ROBO-SLIT and non-neuronal ephrin repulsion confusables.

core: viral RNA genome replication and translation
qualifier: coronavirus replicase, frameshifting and host translation subversion
name: Viral translation, host translation evasion and coronavirus genome replication
rationale: Members concern viral protein synthesis (frameshifting, termination-reinitiation, capping), evasion of PKR/IFIT and host translation, and SARS-CoV replicase-driven genome replication, unlike confusables on retroviral integration or influenza/RSV vRNP transcription.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis/degradation and PLC-calcium coupling
name: GPCR-coupled cAMP turnover and PLC calcium second messengers
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cAMP biosynthesis and PDE1 degradation together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, distinguishing it from adrenergic adenylate-cyclase inhibition and PKA/CREB downstream confusables.

core: cellular monovalent and magnesium ion homeostasis
qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase pumps and renal sodium transport
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-driven sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members concern sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and renal sodium transport, unlike confusables on paracellular tight-junction transport or potassium channels setting membrane potential.

qualifier: replication fork reversal
name: DNA topology and conformation change including fork reversal
rationale: All three members concern changes in DNA topology or geometry, including replication fork reversal, unlike telomere-maintenance and DNA-protein crosslink confusables.

qualifier: copper and manganese, MTF1/metallothionein response
name: Copper and manganese homeostasis and metallothionein metal response
rationale: Members concern copper, manganese, zinc and iron handling with MTF1/metallothionein responses, where copper/manganese transport and the metal-responsive transcription arm distinguish it from zinc/cadmium transport confusables.

qualifier: mucosal lymphoid tissue and lymphocyte homing
name: Secondary and mucosal lymphoid tissue development with lymphocyte homing
rationale: Members cover lymph node and MALT/GALT development, B cell chemotaxis and marginal zone differentiation, and lymphocyte entry into lymphoid organs, distinguishing it from generic chemokine/S1P migration confusables.

qualifier: circadian clock and glucocorticoid response
name: Circadian and glucocorticoid control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members link BMAL1:CLOCK circadian output and glucocorticoid responses to gluconeogenesis, beta-cell growth and hormone secretion; glucocorticoid response separates it from core-clock/PGC-1alpha confusables and the circadian/gluconeogenic arm from HPA cortisol secretion.

name: Cytoplasmic stress granule assembly and disassembly
rationale: All three members concern formation, protein recruitment to and disassembly of stress granules, unlike aggresome, autophagy and proteasome confusables.

qualifier: inhibition of glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
name: Inhibition of insulin signaling, glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
rationale: Members concern dampening insulin receptor signaling and its outputs of glucose import and glycogen synthesis, contrasting with confusables on positive GLUT4/glucose uptake, adiponectin or glucagon-driven glycogenolysis.
